title: Barangay API
body:
A containerizable FastAPI application for the list of Philippine regions,
provinces, cities, municipalities, and barangay according to the August 2025
masterlist from Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC) Release.

This project is a FastAPI wrapper around the
[barangay](https://pypi.org/project/barangay) package, providing a simple and
efficient way to interact with the Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC) data.

Features include a performant fuzzy-search for barangays (0.02s per match), and
traversible REST API endpoints for Philippine administrative areas, and PSGC focused
REST API endpoints.

title: BetterGov.ph
summary: A community‐led initiative to build a more usable Philippine national government website; open, volunteer-driven, aiming to improve how citizens access government services and information.
body: BetterGov.ph is an open-source, volunteer-driven project that reimagines the Philippine government’s online presence. Its goal is to make government information and services more accessible, transparent, and user-friendly through community-built technology.

title: BetterGov SSO Account Application
summary: Dedicated identity provider that gives BetterGov users a single account with secure login, JWT-based SSO, and staged security upgrades.
body: The BetterGov SSO Account Application will power unified sign-ins across BetterGov services, starting with username and password authentication, JWT token exchange, and basic audit logs, then expanding to encryption layers, multi-factor verification, social logins, and government ID integrations.

body: FloodWatch Philippines equips activists and citizens with interactive corruption maps, evidence toolkits, anonymous reporting, and progress dashboards to investigate ₱1.089 trillion in flood-control spending.

title: LottoLens PH Public PCSO Data
summary: Source-traceable Philippine PCSO draw schedules and historical results published as reusable open data.
body:
LottoLens PH Public PCSO Data publishes a reusable draw-schedule table and a
fixed historical snapshot of 13,457 results across nine Philippine Charity
Sweepstakes Office games. Each historical row retains a source name and source
URL, while the package also includes field definitions, Frictionless Data
metadata, validation notes, citation metadata, and fixed release tags.

The project helps Filipino developers, researchers, journalists, and members of
the public inspect historical result records without relying on screenshots or
undocumented copies. It is independently maintained, is not affiliated with
PCSO, does not predict future results, and directs users to official PCSO
channels as the final authority. Readers can review the
[coverage and verification methodology](https://lottolensph.com/research/pcso-results-data-coverage)
before reusing the snapshot.

title: OpenVerify
summary: Unofficial API wrapper that verifies PhilSys and eGov QR codes to make identity validation easier for civic-tech projects.
body: OpenVerify exposes the working flows for PhilID v1, PhilID v3 / ePhilID, and other eGovPH ID verification via a unified interface, while inviting contributors to harden missing data handling, build secure API endpoints, and design a better user interface.

title: Petitions
summary: Start, sign, and share petitions to decision-makers without creating an account. Each email address counts once.

title: Philippine Contributions Calculator
summary: A free website, REST API, and TypeScript library for Philippine statutory contributions, starting with SSS and growing to cover PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG.
body: SSS coverage is available today. PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG are planned, and the project does not yet claim to calculate them.

title: PH Hotlines Directory
summary: Directory of localized emergency hotlines across Philippine cities, seeded with Cavite data and open for contributions.
body: PH Hotlines Directory compiles emergency contact numbers per Philippine locality, inviting volunteers to expand coverage, improve data quality, and support BetterGov initiatives.

title: PhilGEPS Browser
summary: Browse Philippine government procurement opportunities and records.

title: Philippine Projects Heatmap
summary: Visual tracker of Philippine projects with mocked data today, heading toward live datasets and contributor workflows.
body: The Philippine Projects Heatmap maps infrastructure initiatives and plans to integrate sources like PHILGEPS Awards, with contributions needed for data ingestion, contributor docs, and deployment automation.

title: Philippine Quiz
summary: Test your knowledge of Philippine history, culture, government, and geography.

title: Philippines Tax Directory
summary: Community-maintained guide that centralizes Philippine tax information, resources, and references for developers and citizens.
body: The Philippines Tax Directory aims to become a comprehensive catalog of tax rules, forms, and guidance tailored for Philippine contexts, inviting contributors to expand coverage and keep resources accurate.

title: Politiko
summary: Explore members of the 20th Congress through an approachable, swipe-based civic discovery experience.

title: Price Guides
summary: Explore essential economic indicators including market prices, fuel prices, exchange rates, and related public data.

title: PSGC API
summary: Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC) API written in Rust
body:
An over-engineered Rust implementation of the Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC) API. This project serves as a
rewrite of the original PSGC-API, leveraging Rust's performance and safety features along with modern database
technologies.

title: RE:GOV
summary: An AI agent that crawls a legacy Philippine government website and rebuilds it as an accessible concept site on the BetterGov.ph Kapwa design system, with a migration report.
body: Generated sites are unofficial concepts; agency names, seals and content belong to their respective institutions. The live instance limits concurrent runs and rate-limits submissions, and every site in the showcase was built from public pages or a Wayback Machine capture.

title: SALN Tracker PH
summary: A web platform for tracking and displaying Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) of Philippine government officials to promote transparency and accountability.
body: SALN Tracker Philippines is a web platform that tracks and displays the Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) of Philippine government officials. Its goal is to promote transparency and accountability by making SALN disclosures easier to access and understand for citizens.

title: ScamCheck
summary: Paste a suspicious text, upload a screenshot, or forward an email to check it for scam signals. Then learn what to do next and where to report it.

title: StartupDatabase.ph
summary: Discover Filipino startups, products, founders, investors, jobs, and ecosystem research in a curated community directory.

title: Statistics Explorer
summary: Find Philippine Statistics Authority OpenSTAT datasets by topic, explore results, and download exact selections with source dates.

title: Transparency Portal
summary: Search and browse Philippine government procurement, tax, budget, and infrastructure records in one public interface.

title: Action for Economic Reforms (AER)
summary: Independent policy research and advocacy organization working on fiscal policy, tax reform, macroeconomic governance, and social protection.

title: AltMobility PH
summary: Civil society advocacy group pushing for people-first public transport, active mobility, and inclusive urban transport policy in the Philippines.

title: Bantay Kita
summary: National coalition of civil society organizations advocating for transparency and accountability in the extractive industries and natural resource governance.

title: Citizens' Disaster Response Center (CDRC)
summary: Philippine non-governmental organization pioneering community-based disaster management, preparedness, and emergency relief.

title: Center for Trade Union and Human Rights (CTUHR)
summary: Non-profit research and advocacy organization documenting labor rights violations, wage standards, and workplace conditions across the Philippines.

title: E-Net Philippines
summary: Civil Society Network for Education Reforms advocating for inclusive, equitable, and accessible quality education across Philippine communities.

title: Foundation for Media Alternatives (FMA)
summary: Non-profit organization defending digital rights, data privacy, online safety, and equitable ICT access in the Philippines.

title: Government Watch (G-Watch)
summary: Independent citizen action and accountability research organization empowering communities to monitor public service delivery and local budgets.

title: Health Action Information Network (HAIN)
summary: Philippine non-profit organization conducting public health research, community health education, and health policy advocacy.

title: Haribon Foundation
summary: Pioneer Philippine environmental conservation CSO working on biodiversity protection, forest restoration, and community-led natural resource stewardship.

title: Kontra Daya
summary: Broad-based election watchdog coalition monitoring automated election systems, campaign finance, and electoral integrity.

title: NAMFREL
summary: National Citizens Movement for Free Elections — pioneer citizen-led election monitoring and parallel vote count organization in the Philippines.

title: Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism
summary: Independent, non-profit investigative media agency producing data-driven reporting on governance, public accountability, and justice.

title: Right to Know, Right Now! Coalition
summary: Civil society coalition campaigning for the passage of a comprehensive Freedom of Information law and proactive public disclosure.

title: VERA Files
summary: Non-profit media organization founded by veteran Filipino journalists focused on fact-checking, public accountability, and human rights.
